specification:
## Goals
Add Perc, a statistical transform that replaces observations with percentiles and records each percentile.

## Scope
Implement it in seaborn._stats.order, export it from seaborn.objects for use as a Stat in Plot.add, document it, and add a v0.12.1 release note.

## Data model
Return one row per requested percentile per group, with the computed value in the orientation-selected column and its level in percentile. Use GroupBy to preserve group keys, labels, order, and column arrangement. Other input columns and original coordinates may be dropped.

## API contracts
Expose Perc with k=5 and method="linear". An integer k requests that many evenly spaced levels from 0 to 100 inclusive; a list supplies levels in [0, 100]. Follow Stat’s call contract: accept data, GroupBy, orientation, and variable-to-Scale mappings; return a data frame.

## Module architecture
Subclass Stat in the statistics layer alongside ordering statistics. Do not implement this as aggregation or a standalone plotting operation.

## Implementation constraints
Declare orientation grouping. Compute percentiles on y for horizontal plots and x for vertical plots. Apply a per-group data-frame transform through GroupBy.apply. Plot dispatch may provide separate orientation groups. Ignore missing observations while retaining all requested levels.

## Dependencies
Use existing NumPy, pandas, GroupBy, Scale, Stat, and Version abstractions; add no dependencies. For NumPy before 1.22.0, pass method as interpolation; otherwise pass it as method.

## Validation
Let NumPy reject unsupported levels or methods. Do not add list-length or interval-specific validation that changes NumPy behavior.

## Documentation
Document parameters, integer-generated levels, explicit lists, percentile-row output, the linear default, and NumPy’s methods: inverted_cdf, averaged_inverted_cdf, closest_observation, interpolated_inverted_cdf, hazen, weibull, linear, median_unbiased, normal_unbiased, lower, higher, midpoint, nearest. In public so docs, show default quartiles and endpoints, an integer count, explicit levels, and Perc combined with a range mark for an interval. Add Perc to the Stat objects autosummary in doc/api.rst and mention objects.Perc in v0.12.1 release notes.

## Compatibility
Keep seaborn._stats.order.Perc and seaborn.objects.Perc importable.

## Test requirements
Any changed or added tests must match statistics-test fixture and class style. Cover counts, explicit levels, values, method, both orientations, missing data, group labels and order, output columns, both imports, and Plot.add with marks. Direct tests must account for orientation grouping and assert labels and output columns rather than unrelated source columns; import only names used by tests.
